'''Merish Alze''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], she was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]].

==Behind the scenes==
Merish first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Classic Gear Vendor on Ilum for the Empire.<ref name="TOR" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' provided a last name of "Alze" for her.
